claim: The complete 96-shard Kimi-K3 checkpoint image was byte-verified against the Hugging Face metadata sha256 ground truth and every tensor was census-scanned: 497,220 tensors, 0 NaN, 0 Inf, 0 structural anomalies.

model_identity.name: Kimi-K3 (Hugging Face safetensors image, 96 shards, ~1.5 TB)

configuration.note: resumable; skips sealed shards; stopped deliberately at 96/96 before its end_utc re-verify loop

aggregate_root_rule: sha256 over one line per shard row in shard-name order: '<shard><SP><shard_sha256><SP><ledger_row_sha256><LF>'

raw_evidence_custody.statement: The 96 per-shard census ledgers (per-tensor statistics), the shard byte-verification receipt, the seal receipt, and the scanner source remain in the operator's private estate tree on OCTO-L01, off-repository. This capsule commits one allowlisted row per shard (shard byte identity, tensor count, dtype/shape summary, NaN/Inf/structural counts, ledger-row digest), the scanner identity, and the aggregate root. Any dispute reopens the raw ledgers against ledger_row_sha256.
